_note: Derived from shots.json (125 long-form shots, fresh VPW re-author). RE-RUN under the ASSERTIVE device-card rule: device cards are the PRIMARY on-brand motion for this numbers-driven finance story. 111 shots pass through baked (layers []); 14 carry Family-A motion — 10 engine DEVICE CARDS (promote-and-subtract on payoff figures / section-turns / an office-pin reveal) + 4 CUTOUT layers (L03 ship path, L13 MacGregor slide-reveal, L68 SOLD slam, L91 king slide). Camera stays LOCKED (no camera moves). A card-only number shot keeps background scenes/<id>.png (NOT a plate_prompt, per the image-gen card-only contract) and carries an explicit background.subtract directive naming the exact baked figure image-gen must OMIT from that scene; the engine card supplies the real type. Only cutout-bearing shots carry a plate_prompt. Human-cost counts (L96 ten crosses, L103 250/<50 survival ratio, L11) stay baked — the device register goes OFF on human-cost. Incidental dates/page-counts (350 pages, Oct 1823, 1845) stay diegetic. Pictorial ghost-strike enumerations on held sets (L23/L88/L94) stay baked as integrated accretions.
